name: create-effeck 0.0.1
author: maya
body:
Create an Effeck application with `npm create effeck@latest my-app`.

The starter pins the compiler, runtime and Vite plugin to 0.0.1, includes a service and typed error, and tests with @effect/vitest. macOS on Apple silicon and Linux on x64 were tested for 0.0.1; other listed platforms remain unverified.

Version: [packages/create-effeck/package.json](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/packages/create-effeck/package.json?L=3).
